errors.wrong: RowE(IsGoodE(p.s) ∧ R, Lk, E) ∧ ∀ 𝒜 ∀ σ, IsSel(IsGoodE(p.s) ∧ R, Lk, E, 𝒜, σ) ⇒ Closed(D3(3, 𝒜), LinkN)
errors.right: RowE(sAnd(IsGoodE(p.s), R), Lk, E) ∧ ∀ 𝒜 ∀ σ, IsSel(sAnd(IsGoodE(p.s), R), Lk, E, 𝒜, σ) ⇒ Closed(D3(3, 𝒜), LinkN)
errors.why: The Lean text of Lg1 reads `∃ R : V4.Slot, LargeBaseCondition KP Q R ∧ r (sAnd Q' R)`, and the dossier does not show the body of sAnd, so writing the sign ∧ in place of the name sAnd asserts a meaning that the dossier does not give.
